body.zh-Hant: 岡村寧次（1884—1966）出身東京，畢業於陸軍士官學校第16期與陸軍大學校。1921年他赴歐洲出差，在當地與永田鐵山、小畑敏四郎接觸，其後透過二葉會等中堅軍官團體推動軍事改革。
body.en: Okamura Yasuji (1884-1966) came from Tokyo and graduated from the Army Academy (16th class) and the Army War College. In 1921 he travelled to Europe, where he met Nagata Tetsuzan and Obata Toshishiro, and he later pushed army reform through mid-ranking officer groups such as the Futaba-kai.

citations.quote: 没年昭和41(1966)年9月2日
陸軍軍人。東京都出身。陸軍士官学校（16期），陸軍大学校卒。
1921年ヨーロッパに出張，現地で永田鉄山，小畑敏四郎と接触し
二葉会などの中堅将校集団を通じて軍改革をはかる

heading.zh-Hant: 關東軍與塘沽停戰協定
heading.en: Kwantung Army and the Tanggu Truce

body.zh-Hant: 1932年他由上海派遣軍參謀副長轉任關東軍參謀副長。1933年5月31日在河北省塘沽，他以關東軍參謀副長（少將）身分擔任日方代表，與中方熊斌中將簽署《停戰協定》（塘沽停戰協定），滿洲事變因此告一段落。
body.en: In 1932 he moved from deputy chief of staff of the Shanghai Expeditionary Army to deputy chief of staff of the Kwantung Army. On 31 May 1933 at Tanggu in Hebei he signed the truce agreement as Japan's representative, as Kwantung Army deputy chief of staff and major general, opposite Lieutenant General Xiong Bin; the Manchurian Incident was thereby brought to a pause.

citations.quote: 7年上海派遣軍参謀副長から関東軍参謀副長。
昭和 8 年 5 月 31 日、河北省塘沽（タンクー）において
日本側代 表の関東軍参謀副長の岡村少将と
中国側代表の北平分会総参議の熊斌 （ユウヒン）中将との間で調印された「停戦ニ関スル協定」
これにより満州事変は一段落しまし た

heading.zh-Hant: 日中戰爭中的軍司令官
heading.en: Army commands in the China war

body.zh-Hant: 1938年他任第11軍司令官，參加漢口攻略戰役；1941年晉升大將，並出任北支那方面軍司令官。1942年4月18日美軍航空母艦搭載的轟炸機首度空襲東京（杜立德空襲）時，他正擔任北支那方面軍司令官。
body.en: In 1938 he commanded the 11th Army and took part in the Hankou offensive; he was promoted general in 1941 and became commander of the North China Area Army. When carrier-borne US bombers first raided Tokyo on 18 April 1942 (the Doolittle Raid), he was commander of the North China Area Army.

citations.quote: 38年第11軍司令官として漢口攻略戦に参加。

16年北支那方面軍司令官

heading.zh-Hant: 支那派遣軍總司令官與戰後
heading.en: China Expeditionary Army and after the war

body.zh-Hant: 1944年他出任支那派遣軍總司令官，指揮大陸打通作戰，直到戰敗。1945年他向中國軍投降，1947年在中國軍事法庭入監，1949年獲判無罪返日。戰後他支持中華民國。
body.en: In 1944 he became commander-in-chief of the China Expeditionary Army and directed the Ichi-Go (continental traverse) operation until Japan's defeat. He surrendered to the Chinese army in 1945, was imprisoned after appearing before a Chinese military court in 1947, and returned to Japan in 1949 after an acquittal. After the war he supported the Republic of China.

citations.quote: 44年支那派遣軍総司令官となり敗戦をむかえた。
19年支那派遣軍総司令官となり,大陸打通(だつう)作戦を指揮した。
20年中国軍に投降。22年中国軍法廷に出頭入監。24年無罪となり帰国。
戦後は中華民国支持につとめた。

body.zh-Hant: 南雲忠一（1887—1944）出身山形，1908年11月畢業於海軍兵學校第36期，此後主要走水雷系統。他1935年11月晉升少將並任第1水雷戰隊司令官，1937年11月任海軍水雷學校長，1939年11月晉升中將，1940年11月任海軍大學校校長。
body.en: Nagumo Chuichi (1887-1944) was born in Yamagata and graduated from the Naval Academy (36th class) in November 1908, afterwards serving chiefly in the torpedo branch. He became a rear admiral and commander of the 1st Destroyer Flotilla in November 1935, head of the Torpedo School in November 1937, a vice admiral in November 1939 and president of the Naval War College in November 1940.

citations.quote: 海兵卒後、主として水雷畑を歩き
1935.11少将・第1水戦司令官、1937.11海軍水雷校長

body.zh-Hant: 1941年4月南雲任第1航空艦隊司令長官。同年12月8日的夏威夷作戰中，他以中將身分指揮航空母艦機動部隊。防衛研究所所藏戰訓評價該作戰「好機ヲ捕捉シテ奇襲ニ成功」。其後他也指揮機動部隊參與印度洋作戰、中途島海戰與所羅門海戰。
body.en: In April 1941 Nagumo became commander-in-chief of the First Air Fleet. In the Hawaii operation of 8 December 1941 he commanded the carrier striking force as a vice admiral; the lessons-learned report held by the NIDS judges it to have caught a good opportunity and achieved surprise. He also led the carrier force in the Indian Ocean operation, the Battle of Midway and the Solomons battles.

citations.quote: 1941.4第1航空艦隊司令長官
昭和 16 年 12 月 8 日のハワイ作 戦で、第 1 航空艦隊司令長官（当時中将）として空母機動部隊を指揮し ます
好機ヲ捕捉シテ奇襲ニ 成功
同年12月の真珠湾攻撃やインド洋作戦、ミッドウェー海戦、ソロモン海戦で空母機動隊を指揮した

body.zh-Hant: 1942年6月，南雲再度率領機動部隊參加中途島作戰，損失航空母艦4艘與大量艦載機。防衛研究所所藏第1航空艦隊戰鬥詳報（1942年5月27日至6月9日）提出須強化索敵等教訓；人名事典則記載他因暗號洩漏與索敵不完全而被追究作戰失敗的責任。1942年7月他改任第3艦隊司令長官。
body.en: In June 1942 Nagumo again led the carrier force at Midway and lost four carriers and many aircraft. The First Air Fleet battle report (27 May-9 June 1942) held by the NIDS calls for stronger reconnaissance, among other lessons, while a biographical dictionary says he was held responsible for the failure because of leaked codes and incomplete scouting. In July 1942 he became commander-in-chief of the Third Fleet.

citations.quote: 昭和17年6月、再び機動部隊を率いてミッドウェー作戦に参加した
空母4隻とその艦載機多数を失うという 大損害を被ります
昭和17年5 月27日～同年6月9日
索敵ノ強化
暗号の漏えいと索敵の不完全などで作戦失敗の責任を問われる
1942.7第3艦隊司令長官

body.zh-Hant: 1942年11月南雲任佐世保鎮守府司令長官，1943年6月任吳鎮守府司令長官，同年10月任第1艦隊司令長官。1944年3月他兼任中部太平洋方面艦隊與第14航空艦隊司令長官，同年7月8日在塞班島自決，死後晉升大將。
body.en: Nagumo became commander-in-chief of the Sasebo Naval District in November 1942, of the Kure Naval District in June 1943 and of the First Fleet in October 1943. In March 1944 he took the Central Pacific Area Fleet together with the 14th Air Fleet, and on 8 July 1944 he killed himself on Saipan; he was promoted admiral posthumously.

body.zh-Hant: 土肥原賢二（1883—1948）1883年8月8日生於岡山縣，1904年10月畢業於陸軍士官學校第16期，1912年畢業於陸軍大學校，是軍中的「中國通」，也是陸軍具代表性的特務機關長之一。
body.en: Doihara Kenji (1883-1948) was born in Okayama Prefecture on 8 August 1883, graduated from the Army Academy (16th class) in October 1904 and from the Army War College in 1912. He was an Army "China hand" and one of its best-known special-service-agency chiefs.

陸大〔明治45年〕卒

heading.zh-Hant: 滿洲事變與奉天特務機關
heading.en: Manchurian Incident and the Mukden agency

body.zh-Hant: 1931年8月土肥原任奉天特務機關長，滿洲事變爆發後旋即兼任奉天市長，並透過袁金鎧組成遼寧地方治安維持委員會。同年11月他在天津策動暴動（第一次天津事件），並趁亂將溥儀移送滿洲。
body.en: In August 1931 Doihara became chief of the Mukden special service agency; right after the Manchurian Incident he became mayor of Mukden and had Yuan Jinkai set up the Liaoning Peace Maintenance Committee. In November 1931 he provoked riots in Tianjin (the first Tianjin Incident) and used the confusion to move Puyi to Manchuria.

袁金鎧(えんきんがい)を通じて傀儡(かいらい)組織遼寧(りょうねい)地方治安維持委員会をつくらせる

溥儀(ふぎ)

body.zh-Hant: 1933年10月土肥原再任奉天特務機關長，推動內蒙工作；1935年6月簽訂土肥原—秦德純協定，同年11月促成冀東防共自治委員會成立。1938年他謀劃擁立吳佩孚；同年7月26日五相會議決定設「對支特別委員會」，陸軍代表為土肥原中將。
body.en: In October 1933 Doihara again became chief of the Mukden agency and advanced the Inner Mongolia scheme; in June 1935 he concluded the Doihara-Qin Dechun agreement, and in November the East Hebei Anti-Communist Autonomous Council was launched. In 1938 he schemed to bring out Wu Peifu; the Five Ministers' Conference of 26 July 1938 decided on a China special committee with Lieutenant General Doihara as the Army representative.

1938年には、和平工作の一環として旧直隷(ちょくれい)系軍閥呉佩孚(ごはいふ)の担ぎ出しを画策
五相会議は7月26日

body.zh-Hant: 1937年土肥原任第14師團長，1939年任第5軍司令官，1941年晉升大將並任航空總監，1943年任東部軍司令官，1944年任第7方面軍司令官（新加坡），1945年任教育總監，戰敗時為第12方面軍司令官。戰後他以A級戰犯被起訴，1948年12月23日被處絞刑。
body.en: Doihara commanded the 14th Division in 1937 and the 5th Army in 1939, became a general and Inspector General of Aviation in 1941, commanded the Eastern District Army in 1943 and the Seventh Area Army (Singapore) in 1944, and became Inspector General of Military Education in 1945; at the surrender he commanded the Twelfth Area Army. Indicted as a Class-A war criminal, he was executed on 23 December 1948.

heading.zh-Hant: 滿洲事變、天津事件與作戰記載
heading.en: Manchurian Incident, Tientsin incident and recorded operations

body.zh-Hant: 來源明載的軍事行動集中在滿洲事變前後。土肥原1931年8月任奉天特務機關長，滿洲事變爆發後旋即就任奉天市長；同年11月在天津策動中國人的反張學良暴動（第一次天津事件），並趁混亂把日本租界內的溥儀移送滿洲。人名事典另稱他自昭和3年（1928）起以奉天督軍顧問、奉天特務機關長身分參與滿洲事變，並在滿洲建國過程中活動。這些來源是以謀略與政治工作的形式記述這些事件，並未以會戰形式描寫；本批來源也未明載他任第14師團長期間所參與的具體作戰或會戰，該部分仍待查證。
body.en: The operations the sources record cluster around the Manchurian Incident. Doihara became head of the Mukden special service agency in August 1931 and, right after the Incident broke out, mayor of Mukden; in November 1931 he instigated an anti-Zhang Xueliang riot by Chinese in Tientsin (the first Tientsin Incident) and, in the confusion, moved Puyi out of the Japanese concession to Manchuria. A biographical dictionary adds that from 1928 he took part in the Incident as adviser to the Mukden warlord and agency head. The sources treat these events as intrigue, not set-piece battles; none records the operations or campaigns of his 14th Division command, which remains to be verified.

body.zh-Hant: 大山巌（1842—1916）出身鹿兒島藩，是西鄉隆盛的堂弟，1842年10月10日生。他1870年起赴歐洲並留學法國，觀察普法戰爭，歸國後投入陸軍建設；他也參加過戊辰戰爭。
body.en: Oyama Iwao (1842-1916) came from the Satsuma domain and was a cousin of Saigo Takamori. He went to Europe from 1870, studied in France and observed the Franco-Prussian War, and after returning worked on building up the army. He had also taken part in the Boshin War.

citations.quote: 薩摩(さつま)藩出身で西郷隆盛(さいごうたかもり)の従弟(いとこ)。天保(てんぽう)13年10月10日生まれ。
明治3(1870)年フランスに留学、普仏戦争を観戦。
帰国後、陸軍の建設に当たる。
戊辰戦争(ぼしんせんそう)に参加し

body.zh-Hant: 1877年西南戰爭爆發，大山以旅團司令長官兼攻城砲隊指揮長官的身分出征。同年4月20日起，他率領的別働旅團在熊本城東方的保田窪攻擊薩軍陣地，一度因反擊陷入危機。
body.en: When the Satsuma Rebellion broke out in 1877, Oyama went to the front as a brigade commander and as commander of the siege artillery. From 20 April, his detached brigade attacked Satsuma positions at Yasudakubo east of Kumamoto Castle and was briefly in danger after a counter-attack.

citations.quote: 明治 10 年 2 月に勃発した西南戦争 に旅団司令長官及び攻城砲隊指揮長官として参加しました
明治 10 年 4 月 20 日から熊本 城の東方にある保田窪
薩軍の反撃を受けて一時危機に陥っ た

heading.zh-Hant: 陸軍卿、陸相與日清戰爭
heading.en: War minister and the Sino-Japanese War

body.zh-Hant: 1880年2月大山兼任陸軍卿，1885年12月任第1次伊藤內閣陸軍大臣，其後任職至1896年9月；1886年7月至1887年7月兼任海軍大臣。1891年5月晉升陸軍大將，1894年9月任第2軍司令官，參加日清戰爭；1898年1月獲元帥稱號。
body.en: He became concurrently army minister (rikugun-kyo) in February 1880 and War Minister in the first Ito cabinet in December 1885, serving until September 1896; from July 1886 to July 1887 he also held the navy portfolio. He was promoted general in May 1891, commanded the Second Army from September 1894 in the Sino-Japanese War, and received the title of Marshal in January 1898.

body.zh-Hant: 日俄戰爭中大山任滿洲軍總司令官（1904年5月，國會圖書館記載），指揮部隊在遼陽、旅順取勝，1905年3月又在奉天會戰獲勝；同年6月5日，他在日本海海戰後向各軍司令官下達訓示，告誡軍紀鬆弛。1905年12月再任參謀總長，1907年9月封公爵，1914年4月任內大臣，1916年12月10日去世。
body.en: In the Russo-Japanese War Oyama was commander-in-chief of the Manchurian Army (May 1904 per the National Diet Library); the army won at Liaoyang and Port Arthur and, in March 1905, at Mukden. On 5 June 1905 he issued an instruction to his army commanders warning against slack discipline. He again became chief of the General Staff in December 1905, was made a prince in September 1907, Lord Keeper of the Privy Seal in April 1914, and died on 10 December 1916.

body.zh-Hant: 大西瀧治郎（1891—1945）1891年6月2日生於兵庫縣，1912年7月畢業於海軍兵學校第40期，此後幾乎都從事航空相關職務。他在橫須賀海軍航空隊副長兼教頭任內主張海軍重心須由戰艦轉向飛機，1937年提出《航空軍備ニ關スル研究》，主張以強大的基地航空兵力維持制海權。
body.en: Onishi Takijiro (1891-1945) was born in Hyogo Prefecture on 2 June 1891 and graduated from the Naval Academy (40th class) in July 1912; thereafter he served almost entirely in aviation posts. As deputy commander and head of instruction of the Yokosuka Air Group he argued that the navy should shift its emphasis from battleships to aircraft, and in 1937 he submitted a study arguing that sea control rested on strong land-based air power.

heading.zh-Hant: 日中戰爭與珍珠港計畫研究
heading.en: China war and the Hawaii attack study

body.zh-Hant: 1939年10月大西任第2連合航空隊司令官，1940年11月任第1連合航空隊司令官；人名事典稱他在日中戰爭中從攻擊機上親自指揮。1941年1月任第11航空艦隊參謀長，並被山本五十六命令研究夏威夷攻擊計畫。
body.en: In October 1939 Onishi became commander of the 2nd Combined Air Group and in November 1940 of the 1st Combined Air Group; a biographical dictionary says that in the China war he led from the front aboard attack aircraft. In January 1941 he became chief of staff of the 11th Air Fleet and was ordered by Yamamoto Isoroku to study a Hawaii attack plan.

heading.zh-Hant: 第1航空艦隊與神風特攻隊
heading.en: First Air Fleet and the kamikaze corps

body.zh-Hant: 1944年10月大西任第1航空艦隊司令長官。戰局惡化下，他於10月25日組織「神風特別攻擊隊」，並下令第一次特攻出擊；防衛研究所稱此為對敵空母的體當攻擊第1號，人名事典則稱這是雷伊泰作戰中首次特攻。
body.en: In October 1944 Onishi became commander-in-chief of the First Air Fleet. With the war turning against Japan he organised the "Kamikaze Special Attack Corps" on 25 October and ordered the first suicide sortie; the NIDS describes this as the first ramming attack on an enemy carrier, and a biographical dictionary places it in the Leyte operation.

heading.en: Vice chief of the Naval General Staff and suicide

body.zh-Hant: 1945年5月大西任軍令部次長。日本戰敗後，他自決：防衛研究所記為1945年8月15日，20世紀日本人名事典記為8月16日。
body.en: In May 1945 Onishi became vice chief of the Naval General Staff. After Japan's defeat he took his own life; the NIDS dates this to 15 August 1945, while the Nijusseiki Nihonjin Meijiten gives 16 August.

heading.zh-Hant: 日中戰爭、夏威夷攻擊研究與雷伊泰作戰
heading.en: China war, Hawaii attack study and the Leyte campaign

body.zh-Hant: 大西的作戰相關記載有三點。其一，1937年他提出《航空軍備ニ關スル研究》，主張西太平洋制海權取決於強大的基地航空兵力而非優勢艦隊，防衛研究所稱後來的對美戰爭果如其所料以航空機為中心。其二，日中戰爭中他任航空隊司令官，人名事典稱他從攻擊機上陣頭指揮；1941年任第11航空艦隊參謀長時，被山本五十六命令研究夏威夷攻擊計畫。其三，1944年雷伊泰戰役（作戰）中，他以第1航空艦隊司令長官身分命令初次特攻攻擊機出動。
body.en: Three points in the sources concern his operations. First, in 1937 he submitted a study on air armament arguing that control of the western Pacific depended on powerful land-based air strength rather than a superior fleet; the NIDS says the later war with the US centred on aircraft as he had predicted. Second, in the China war, as an air group commander, a biographical dictionary says he led from the front aboard attack aircraft; as chief of staff of the 11th Air Fleet in 1941 he was ordered by Yamamoto Isoroku to study a Hawaii attack plan. Third, in the 1944 Leyte campaign, as commander-in-chief of the First Air Fleet, he ordered the first special attack aircraft sortie.
